name: transcript-cleanup-toolkit
description: Transcribe audio (Deepgram Nova-3) and produce reviewed, timestamped .docx transcripts with a fidelity-first cleanup workflow: word-level vs utterance-level speaker segmentation, [dudoso]/[inaudible] markers, and an audio-quality diagnostic tree (volume normalization, echo/reverb detection, Whisper fallback) for recordings nova-3 can't handle.
